description: This file defines the MarkerCluster class for managing clusters of map markers in Leaflet, including methods for clustering, bounds calculation, icon creation, and recursive map operations.

classes.name: MarkerCluster
classes.description: A class extending Leaflet's Marker to manage marker clustering, including child markers, child clusters, bounds, and recursive map operations.

methods.name: getAllChildMarkers
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all child markers within the cluster.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of child markers in the cluster.

methods.name: zoomToBounds
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to show all markers within the cluster bounds.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the cluster.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Marks the icon for update and sets the icon if available.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Creates and returns the cluster icon, updating if necessary.

methods.name: createShadow
methods.description: Creates and returns the shadow for the cluster icon.

methods.name: _addChild
methods.description: Adds a child marker or cluster to this cluster, updating counts and hierarchy.

methods.name: _setClusterCenter
methods.description: Sets the cluster center position based on the first child marker or cluster.

methods.name: _resetBounds
methods.description: Resets the cluster bounds to initial invalid values for recalculation.

methods.name: _recalculateBounds
methods.description: Recalculates the cluster bounds based on child markers and clusters.

methods.name: _addToMap
methods.description: Adds the cluster to the map at a specified position.

methods.name: _recursivelyAnimateChildrenIn
methods.description: Animates child markers and clusters into view.

methods.name: _recursivelyAnimateChildrenInAndAddSelfToMap
methods.description: Animates children and adds the cluster to the map at a new zoom level.

methods.name: _recursivelyBecomeVisible
methods.description: Recursively makes the cluster and its children visible.

methods.name: _recursivelyAddChildrenToMap
methods.description: Recursively adds child markers and clusters to the map.

methods.name: _recursivelyRestoreChildPositions
methods.description: Restores positions of child markers and clusters after zoom changes.

methods.name: _restorePosition
methods.description: Restores the cluster's position from backup.

methods.name: _recursivelyRemoveChildrenFromMap
methods.description: Recursively removes child markers and clusters from the map.

methods.name: _recursively
methods.description: Performs recursive operations on child clusters within bounds and zoom levels.

methods.name: _isSingleParent
methods.description: Checks if the cluster is the parent of only one cluster which is itself.
